items.label: Stylish U‑Shaped Silhouette
items.value: Featuring a U‑shaped profile, refined finish, and clean lines, this console table becomes a striking focal point while blending effortlessly with Nordic, farmhouse, and modern minimalist interiors

items.label: Spacious Tabletop
items.value: The 63" wide tabletop of this narrow entryway table offers ample room to keep keys, bags, umbrellas, and everyday essentials neatly organized, while also displaying photos, plants, and decorative accents

items.label: Solid Construction, Built to Last
items.value: Crafted from sturdy particleboard and reinforced by a stable U‑shaped structure, this hallway console table supports up to 198 lb on its thick tabletop, offering strong, reliable support for all your items

items.label: Versatile
items.value: Use it as a behind-sofa table, side table, or entry table in the living room, hallway, foyer, or bedroom—one piece, many possibilities

items.label: Easy Assembly
items.value: The hallway table comes with detailed instructions and clearly labeled parts, so you can assemble it quickly and with ease

Assembly Instructions Description
items.value: Attach legs with screws. Tighten using the provided tool. Insert tabletop support brackets into pre-drilled holes. Secure legs to brackets using included hex bolts. Flip table upright once all connections are secure.

items.label: Included Components
items.value: 1 x Console Table, 1 x Accessory Kit, 1 x Anti-Tip Kit, 1 x Instructions
